summary: Adds a membership-based organization picker to Cloud sign-in and moves workspace switching into the account menu.
userImpact: People can open or switch between the organizations they belong to from the account menu.

changes: The authenticated membership list accepts optional selection hints. Trusted frontend modules can use host router navigation.

security: Organization choices come from authenticated membership. The server validates membership before issuing a tenant session.
documentation: The Cloud gateway serves the organization selection route on the primary application host.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible host application and Cloud gateway.
validation: Browser tests verify selection, switching, deep links, onboarding, account scope, and header continuity.
